prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity decision comp for a web-app redesign
Primary request: Create one 16:9 presentation image showing TWO complete Wicker Study desktop app screens side by side, Settings on the left and Documents on the right. Direction: Source Control Desk.
Input image: reference image supplies the exact Wicker Study app chrome, warm neutral canvas, narrow typography, indigo action color, flat ruled white panels, 14px major corners, sidebar proportions, density, and component character. Do not copy its Courses content.
Screen 1, Settings: persistent Wicker sidebar with Documents under MANAGE, page title "Settings", flat local tabs with Connections active. At top, one compact two-cell connection status band for Canvas and Timetable with status marks and last refresh. Below, a dense white source register with edge-to-edge toolbar and columns SOURCE, ACCESS, CONTENT, HEALTH, ACTION. Canvas uses actual red Canvas LMS mark and shows assignments plus optional private course indexing. Timetable shows feed URL, 212 appointments, refreshed recently. Selecting Canvas expands a full-width inline editor row with token-management note and permissions; selecting Timetable would use the same row grammar.
Screen 2, Documents: persistent same sidebar with Documents active. Page title "Documents", short subtitle, Upload document primary action. A broad dense source table with edge-to-edge toolbar, search and type filter. Rows are Transcript, Academic Work, Academic calendar, Exam schedule. Columns TYPE, CURRENT VERSION, UPDATED, RECORD IMPACT, ACTION. Transcript selected. Directly below selected row, an edge-aligned expanded revision ledger, not a floating card: v3 current, v2, v1 in rows with dates, credits/passed changes, View, Compare and Remove. Include a small compact line plot in the expanded region for factual credit progression.
Style/medium: production SaaS UI screenshot, crisp vector-like interface, not a poster and not a device mockup.
Composition: both screens large and readable, equal scale, minimal outer margin, desktop landscape.
Text (verbatim where prominent): "Settings", "Connections", "Canvas", "Timetable", "Documents", "Upload document", "Search documents", "Transcript", "Academic Work", "Academic calendar", "Revision history", "Compare".
Constraints: no gradients, no glass, no colorful cards, no serif, no decorative eyebrows, no floating short dividers, no nested card stack, no em dash, neutral and indigo only except Canvas vendor red. Dense but calm, student-facing rather than admin software.
